meta.title: How the assistant reaches your app

cards.title: Why registration is not just a manifest entry
items: AppFunctions replaces App Actions and static Shortcuts: the assistant reads the schema at runtime rather than at install time
A function the assistant cannot find is a function you declared but never registered, which is what the functions array reports
Requires API 37, so useAppFunctions reports unsupported on anything older rather than failing at the call

cards.title: What the system checks before your handler runs
items: Only a system assistant package holding the EXECUTE_APP_FUNCTIONS signature permission can invoke a registered function
Arguments are validated against your declared JSON Schema before execution starts, so a handler never sees a malformed call
Invocations carry a 5 second deadline, so a slow handler returns a timeout to the assistant rather than blocking it
